The '''Ord Cestus medical station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the medical facility during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
It was located near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]] worked in the medical center.<ref name="TCW" /> This station looked very similar to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] also used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="SOM">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:OCMS_comm_center.png|thumb|left|200px|Kit Fisto and Nala Se oversee operations on the medical station.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] was stationed at the site.<ref name="TCW" />

In the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were tasked in bringing a [[TB-73/Legends|supply ship]] to the station in order to retrieve medical supplies for [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] forces on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. A clone named [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] brought dozens of [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] eggs into the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] and infected the crew. The ship was taken over by the [[Clone Commander/Legends|clones]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] both [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] and activated the [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]] and the main [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] which prevented anyone going up to the bridge. Tano and Offee managed to gain control back and they safely docked at the center without infecting the people in the station.<ref name="TCW" />
